description: Looking for a dependable pickup that combines power, utility, and modern features? This 2017 Ram 1500 Laramie offers a compelling mix of performance and comfort, making it a versatile choice for work or leisure. With its striking Granite Crystal Metallic Clearcoat exterior and black interior, this used Ram 1500 stands out on the road. Equipped with a robust 5.7-liter V8 engine delivering 395 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque, it provides ample power for towing and hauling. The 8-speed automatic transmission ensures smooth shifts, while the 4WD system enhances traction in tough conditions. This trucks generous features include a backup camera, Bluetooth connectivity, fog lights, heated seats, keyless entry, memory seats, built-in navigation, premium audio, satellite radio readiness, and a tow package, all designed to elevate your driving experience.Despite its used status, this Ram 1500 Laramie remains in solid condition with 143,054 miles that testify to its durability. Whether youre tackling tough jobs or heading out for adventure, this pickup offers a blend of capability and comfort thats hard to beat. Its exteriors gray tone and black interior give it a sleek, refined look, complemented by features that enhance convenience and safety.2017 Ram 1500 Safety and Security FeaturesThis Ram 1500 is equipped with essential safety features including 4-wheel ABS to prevent wheel lock-up during emergency stops. Anti-lockout power door locks provide security, while auto-locking locks enhance safety once the vehicle is in motion. Brake drying technology helps maintain brake performance in wet conditions, ensuring reliable stopping power when needed most.2017 Ram 1500 Entertainment and Technology FeaturesThe truck boasts a comprehensive entertainment system centered around an 8.4-inch touchscreen infotainment display, offering voice-operated radio and hands-free phone call integration for seamless connectivity. Surround sound speakers, including a dedicated subwoofer, deliver rich audio quality for all passengers. Eight speakers and auxiliary USB inputs ensure multiple options for listening, while electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions keeps you connected safely on the road.2017 Ram 1500 Performance FeaturesPerformance is at the core of this Ram 1500, with an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector allowing you to switch modes based on terrain. Its part-time 4WD system with an on-demand setting provides versatility for various driving conditions. Cylinder deactivation technology helps improve efficiency by shutting down cylinders when full power isnt needed, balancing fuel economy with strong performance.Fully detailed. 2017 Ram 1500 Laramie 4WD 8-Speed Automatic HEMI 5.7L V8 Multi Displacement VVTReviews: * Smooth-riding suspension provides plenty of comfort; excellent trio of engine choices; smooth and efficient eight-speed automatic transmission; Rebel 1500 off-road package offers extra capability; cabin is quiet and attractive; touchscreen interface is easy to use.
